question: It was revealed in the bonus novel that one of the former Five Great Countries was called “Magritza.” Could you tell us a little bit about it?
answer:
Magritza was an unpleasant country.

The gap between the rich and poor was extremely severe, and there was a prevailing belief that people who could use magic were superior, while those who couldn't were inferior.

Back when Magritza still existed, there were some people traveling around the world, and among them was this person named Echidna. She was incredibly good at magic. She was treated extremely well because of that.

On the other hand, there was this guy named Reid, and he couldn't use magic at all. So then you have to wonder, “What on earth was Magritza supposed to do with someone like him?” (laughs)

There might be an opportunity in the future for me to write an episode involving “Magritza's Guillotine.”
